limit.description: Maximum number of native conversation turns to include in this history page.

ConversationListRequest.description: Without query/readerScope, preserve existing projectFilter/cursor/limit behavior. query requires its conversationListQuery capability; readerScope additionally requires conversation.unread.list capability and an authoritative read store. updatedAfter intersects projectFilter; ids requires projectFilter.kind=all. With readerScope, return authoritative Conversation.readState for every summary. Cursors bind route, query, projectFilter and readerScope; changing any is invalid_cursor.

ProviderResourceId.description: Provider-private complete route for a provider-native resource.

ReaderScope.description: Opaque reader identity supplied only by the trusted Host from authenticated caller context. Preserve existing callerScope identity and baseline; never accept a Remote-selected scope.

ConversationEnumerationRevision.description: Opaque identity of one immutable active or reader-scoped unread enumeration snapshot within one running instance generation. Equal on every page of that enumeration; a new enumeration may get a different identity even when facts are unchanged. Never compare identities across enumerations, with event invalidation identities, activityVersion, Gateway eventCursor, or recent revision.

ConversationUpdatedAfterQuery.description: Inclusive UTC epoch-millisecond updatedAt boundary. Filter the complete source before pagination, then order updatedAt descending with native ID ascending as tie breaker. Missing updatedAt does not match. No recent-feed policy belongs here.

ConversationIdsQuery.description: Request 1..100 distinct native conversation IDs within route. Filter before pagination; enumerate the full requested set across pages in native ID ascending order. Deleted IDs may be omitted; lookup failures must fail the request, never masquerade as deletion. Larger batches are invalid_request. Requires projectFilter.kind=all; other filters are invalid_request.

ConversationListQueryCapabilities.description: Advertise only modes implemented with complete filtering before pagination. Absent or false means unsupported. readerScope additionally requires conversation.unread.list capability and an available authoritative read store.

ConversationActiveEntry.description: One active conversation. Active includes running, waiting-approval and waiting-user-input execution; preserve existing execution semantics. activityVersion is the existing unread observation version, not this enumeration revision.

ConversationUnreadEntry.description: One unread conversation for the requested readerScope; readState.unread must be true.

ConversationActiveListRequest.description: Enumerate a complete immutable snapshot, default limit 20, maximum 100. Cursor binds route/current generation and, for unread, readerScope. Invalid bindings return invalid_cursor; expired snapshots return conversation_cursor_expired. Unsupported must be an error, never an empty result.

ConversationActiveListResponse.description: All pages belong to one complete snapshot; nextCursor absence alone indicates exhaustion. No arbitrary truncation. Records are ordered by nativeResourceId ascending.

ConversationUnreadListRequest.description: Enumerate a complete immutable snapshot, default limit 20, maximum 100. Cursor binds route/current generation and, for unread, readerScope. Invalid bindings return invalid_cursor; expired snapshots return conversation_cursor_expired. Unsupported must be an error, never an empty result.

ConversationUnreadListResponse.description: All pages belong to one complete snapshot; nextCursor absence alone indicates exhaustion. No arbitrary truncation. Records are ordered by nativeResourceId ascending.

ConversationMarkReadRequest.description: Advance this reader only up to the observed activity version, monotonically and durably. A newer activity remains unread. Preserve baseline/read progress; reject an invalid or future version as invalid_activity_version.

revision.description: Opaque invalidation identity in this ordered event stream, not an enumeration snapshot identity. Never compare with list response.revision or use equality/order to suppress an invalidation; every received event invalidates the affected view.

ConversationActiveChangedEvent.description: Ordered active-set invalidation and current fact, including active=false on exit. revision identifies this invalidation, not any active enumeration snapshot. Events must cover externally observed execution too. Host tracks a local event fence during snapshot construction.

revision.description: Opaque invalidation identity in this ordered event stream, not an enumeration snapshot identity. Never compare with list response.revision or use equality/order to suppress an invalidation; every received event invalidates the affected view.

ConversationUnreadChangedEvent.description: Ordered reader-scoped unread fact/invalidation, including unread=false after markRead. revision identifies this invalidation, not any unread enumeration snapshot. Host must not forward scope or read state to other readers; every activity or markRead event invalidates the affected reader view.

ConversationDeletedEvent.description: Ordered authoritative deletion invalidation. Missing requested IDs are not evidence of deletion unless the Provider established absence. Invalidate affected list/active/unread snapshots.

ProviderDirectories.description: Host-assigned absolute Provider-owned paths, independent of harness storage. Database file must reside directly in data. Provider owns schema and transactions. Never exposed remotely.
